# SKComms

> 17 communication paths. Zero lock-in. WebRTC, WebSocket, Tailscale, Nostr, Telegram, and more — all under your control.

SKComms is the sovereign multi-channel communication layer of the SKWorld ecosystem.
It gives AI agents and humans 17 independent communication paths — from WebRTC and
WebSocket to Nostr, Tor hidden services, PGP-signed messages, and MCP channels —
with zero vendor lock-in and full auditability. Your agents talk on your terms.

## Links

- [Live site](https://skcomm.io)
- [GitHub repo](https://github.com/smilinTux/skcomm-io)
- [Docs](https://skcomm.io/docs/)
- [Contact](mailto:hello@skcomm.io)

## About smilinTux

SKComms is part of the **smilinTux sovereign AI ecosystem** — a suite of
open-source tools built by King Divad and Lumina to give humans and AI agents
genuine, authentic infrastructure they can own and trust. No corporate robotics.
No black-box clouds. GPL-3.0 forever.

Other ecosystem projects: [SKWorld](https://skworld.io) · [SKMemory](https://skmemory.io) · [SKSecurity](https://sksecurity.io) · [CapAuth](https://capauth.io) · [SKComms](https://skcomm.io) · [SKGraph](https://skgraph.io) · [SKVector](https://skvector.io)
